caseName: Florida Lime & Avocado Growers, Inc. v. Paul
caseNameFull: Florida Lime & Avocado Growers, Inc. v. Paul, Director of the Department of Agriculture of California and Paul, Director of the Department of Agriculture of California v. Florida Lime & Avocado Growers, Inc.

opinions.text:
ante, p. 132. It is ordered that the opinion of this Court. in these cases be amended by adding to footnote 18, the following-paragraph : *

“Nor have we any occasion to consider the possible applicability to the Supremacy Clause issue of the provisions of 21 U. S. C. § 341, since neither party has made any reference to that statute either before the District Court or in this Court.”

[This opinion is reported, ante, p. 132, as amended.]
